info.name: fiskaly E-INVOICE IT 2026-06-01
info.description:
This postman collection consists the basic workflow of E-INVOICE IT (Version 2026-06-01) including SDI/FatturaPA e-invoicing. Further information is provided in the [developer documentation](https://workspace.fiskaly.com/unified-api/api-spec/?v=2026-06-01&c=IT_EI).

When this collection is executed with Postman, important parts of the results will be stored in the current selected Postman environment.

**Key Features:**

- E-Invoicing System setup for Italy (IT)
    
- System commissioning workflow
    
- E-Invoice transmission with SDI recipients
    
- E-Invoice correction transmission

item.name: systems (E_INVOICE_SERVICE)

request.description:
This system is used for transmitting e-invoices through SDI.  
Note: Only one `E_INVOICE_SERVICE` system is allowed per Taxpayer.
Retrieve an E-Invoice System by ID

Expected outcome: System goes straight to `state=COMMISSIONED, mode=OPERATIVE` — invoices can be sent right away. To also receive invoices, complete the one-time AdE registration.  
**From here on, Records created in the LIVE environment are legally valid** — they must  
represent real business transactions.
List Systems filtered by Taxpayer ID

item.description:
This system is used for transmitting e-invoices through SDI.  
Note: Only one `E_INVOICE_SERVICE` system is allowed per Taxpayer.

item.name: records (B2B E-Invoice Transmission with SDI recipient)

request.description:
Create an intention for an e-invoice transaction.  
**Note:** if the Taxpayer also uses receipt fiscalization (e.g. SIGN IT),  
create the INTENTION and TRANSACTION on a `FISCAL_DEVICE` System instead (any  
one on the same Taxpayer) — it takes precedence. The `E_INVOICE_SERVICE`  
System still transmits the e-invoice.

Create an e-invoice with an SDI recipient.  
_Important:_

- The `E_INVOICE_SERVICE` system must be in `COMMISSIONED/OPERATIVE` state
    
- The recipient needs `invoicing.type: SDI` with a valid 7-character  
    `destination_code` (_Codice Destinatario_)
    
- The invoice is transmitted through SDI, which returns acceptance or an `NS`  
    rejection
Retrieve the e-invoice record with compliance information
Retrieve the e-invoice record with compliance information
Retrieve the SDI transmission record for the IT invoice / B2C flow after the invoice record exposes used_in.id.

item.name: records (E-Invoice Reception)

request.description:
List records filtered by `type=E_INVOICE::RECEPTION` to look up invoices received automatically via SDI/FatturaPA.

**Note:** Reception records are created by fiskaly when SDI delivers an invoice, not by the integrator — there is no corresponding create request in this collection.

request.description: Retrieve a Receipt as PDF by setting Accept header to application/pdf

item.description: E-Invoice reception workflow: when an invoice is sent via SDI to one of your commissioned taxpayers, fiskaly receives it automatically, creates an `E_INVOICE::RECEPTION` record, and stores the signed XML and the receipt of transmission against that record. This folder shows how to look up incoming invoices and retrieve their XML and receipt of transmission.
